contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: Named contacts are personal data. Unconfirmed or inferred e-mails are not guaranteed; verify before sending.
contacts.officialChannelsSubtitle: Collected from public company pages, structured metadata and switchboard records — non-personal company channels ready for B2B outreach.
contacts.officialChannelsEmpty: No public company e-mails, phones or social profiles captured yet.
contacts.emptyDesc: Discovery shows name, title, department and contact points, with source links and evidence timestamps.
contacts.scopeHint: Contact data is gated by the engine’s narrow contact-discovery:read scope, granted to admins only; if the engine image or role mapping is not ready, the card shows “integration not ready” and stays read-only.
contacts.discoverOnceHint: The discovery grant is bound to the company: discovery can succeed only once per company; contact operations to arrange another attempt (repeat attempts are rejected by the one-time grant).
contacts.guessBlocked: {count} verifications were blocked by the compliance gate (no probes sent).
contacts.missingEmail: {count} contacts do not have a verified work e-mail yet. Use “Find & verify e-mails” to look them up via commercial sources.
contacts.discoverDesc: The engine looks through the website, registries, trade fairs and social sources for named contacts. This can take several minutes and consumes execution budget.
contacts.enrichDesc: Looks up and verifies work e-mails by name and company domain via commercial sources (Hunter / Prospeo). Only verifiable results are stored and execution budget is consumed.
contacts.enrichNoContacts: No named contacts need e-mail lookup, or all already have verified e-mails.

enrichStatus.notAdmitted: Not admitted (no eligible contacts or gated)

contacts.guessDesc: Infers e-mail addresses from the company pattern and performs an SMTP handshake for contacts without one. Inferred results may stay unconfirmed and consume execution budget.
contacts.verifyDesc: Performs one SMTP handshake against {email}; the result is written back to the contact point.
contacts.riskyWarning: This e-mail is unconfirmed or inferred; verification may still not confirm it.
contacts.acknowledge: I understand this e-mail is uncertain and still want to verify it
contacts.noBasis: Discovering or probing named contacts requires an explicit lawful basis; without one the engine refuses before writing any data.

basisHint.legitimate_interest: For B2B outreach: requires a completed LIA; put its reference into “Basis reference”.
basisHint.consent: Only when the person has explicitly consented; cite the consent record.
basisHint.contract: Contact is necessary to perform an existing contract; cite the contract.
basisHint.legal_obligation: Contact or verification is legally required; cite the statute or ticket.

contacts.discoverDone: Discovery finished; {count} contacts are now available.
contacts.guessDone: E-mail guessing finished: {attempted} attempted, {persisted} stored, {verified} verified.
contacts.verifyBlocked: Verification was blocked by the compliance gate (BLOCKED); no probe was sent.

privacy.subtitle: Regional compliance is handled automatically in the background. You only need this page when a buyer asks to stop contact or delete their record.
privacy.autoDesc: Rules apply strictly by region and mailbox type so daily prospecting stays fast while meeting European privacy standards.
privacy.pillarScopeDesc: Buyers in the US, Middle East, APAC, and LATAM, plus generic role inboxes like info or sales, are unaffected.
privacy.pillarFooterTitle: Compact notice in first email footer
privacy.pillarFooterDesc: For EU and UK personal contacts, a brief privacy and opt-out line is appended to the first business email instead of sending a separate legal email.
privacy.pillarFreezeTitle: Instant freeze on opt-out or erasure
privacy.pillarFreezeDesc: Any deletion or do-not-contact request freezes the record and adds a permanent block first, then erases personal data asynchronously.
privacy.rightAccess: Immediate freeze: stops further enrichment and outreach right away
privacy.rightErasure: Full cleanup: removes personal fields for the chosen company or contact
privacy.rightObjection: Permanent suppression: prevents the buyer from being re-added or contacted again
privacy.rightResponse: Count-only receipt: keeps status and deleted counts without retaining personal details
privacy.scopeNote: Backed by GDPR erasure and objection workflows for support or legal requests.
privacy.formTitle: Handle a buyer deletion or opt-out request (Admin / Support)
privacy.formDesc: Not needed for everyday prospecting. Expand below only when a buyer asks to erase their details or stop further emails.
privacy.subjectIdHint: Search and select a company; for an individual contact, paste its record ID
privacy.reasonErasure: Erase personal data & block permanently (GDPR erasure)
privacy.reasonObjection: Buyer opted out & block permanently (GDPR objection)
privacy.requestRefHint: e.g. support ticket ID or email date (do not enter personal names or emails)
privacy.asyncNote: Freezes immediately and cleans up asynchronously; please do not resubmit while processing.
privacy.submitted: Accepted request #{id}; the record is frozen and cleanup is underway
privacy.invalidIdHint: Select a company from the list or copy the full contact ID
privacy.lookupHint: Enter a request ID to check progress
privacy.noTracked: No buyer deletion requests logged yet. No manual action is required for daily outreach.
privacy.subject: Target
privacy.unknownStatus: Not found yet (still queued or belongs to another team)
privacy.trackedNote: Receipts store counts only, never personal data. This list is saved on the server for your workspace so progress stays available across devices.

exports.title: Async workspace data exports (Admin)
exports.desc: Export leads, buyer companies, contacts, outreach records, or a full archive for this workspace. Files are packaged in the background, downloaded via stream, and removed automatically after expiry.
exports.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can start or download bulk data exports. Contact an admin if you need an archive.
exports.created: Created export task #{id}; download will open once packaging completes
exports.empty: No export tasks yet. Choose a scope above to generate a downloadable archive.
exports.note: Only one active export task is allowed at a time; archives follow daily quota and retention limits.

offboarding.title: Workspace offboarding (7-day cooling-off)
offboarding.desc: Admins can schedule full workspace offboarding. A 7-day cooling-off window starts immediately so you can cancel if needed. After the window ends, platform operations executes physical cleanup and stores a zero-personal-data receipt.
offboarding.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can schedule or cancel workspace offboarding.
offboarding.scheduledBanner: Offboarding is scheduled with about {days} day(s) remaining in cooling-off (deadline: {deadline}). You may cancel before the deadline.
offboarding.expiredBanner: The 7-day cooling-off window ended at {deadline}. The workspace is now awaiting physical cleanup by platform operations. Contact operations immediately to halt.
offboarding.cancelledNote: The latest offboarding request was cancelled on {time}. Your workspace remains active.
offboarding.confirmNameLabel: Type the current workspace name to confirm: {name}
offboarding.confirmNameMismatch: Entered name does not match the current workspace name
offboarding.reasonLabel: Reason (optional, do not include personal contact info)
offboarding.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Project completed or migrating workspace
offboarding.submitConfirmContent: “{name}” will enter a 7-day cooling-off window. Once operations completes physical cleanup after the window, all workspace data and files are permanently erased. Admins can cancel any time during cooling-off.
offboarding.submitted: Workspace offboarding scheduled; the 7-day cooling-off window has started
offboarding.cancelConfirmContent: Your workspace will remain active and will not enter physical cleanup.

onboarding.title: Complete your company profile
onboarding.subtitle: Add your website, store link, or product brief — with optional PDF brochures — then confirm to complete setup.

onboarding.storeUrlWhitelistHint: This allowlist applies only to seller onboarding and stays isolated from buyer filtering.
onboarding.brochureTitle: Attach product brochures (optional PDF, up to 5 files, 50MB each)
onboarding.brochureHint: Submit alongside your website, store, or product brief, or continue with a brochure alone. Files are saved to your company library and parsed in the background without blocking the next step.

onboarding.brochureUploadedCount: {count} brochure(s) uploaded and queued for background parsing.
onboarding.brochureTooLarge: Each PDF brochure must be 50MB or smaller.
onboarding.brochureMaxCount: Up to 5 brochures here; you can upload more in your company library later.
onboarding.brochureNeedName: Enter your company name before continuing.
onboarding.brochureInvalidType: Only PDF (.pdf) brochure files are supported here.
onboarding.waitingBrochureLinked: {count} product brochure(s) queued for background upload & parsing
onboarding.brochureLargeHint: Selected brochures total {size}. High-resolution print files take longer to upload — after submitting you can continue right away while brochures keep uploading in the background, or add large files later in your company library.
onboarding.brochureStatusServerFailed: Parsing failed — retry later in company library
onboarding.brochureActiveUploadWarn: {count} brochure upload(s) are still in progress. Completing setup now will stop unfinished uploads; completed files keep parsing in the background and others can be added later in your company library.
onboarding.brochureClaimsTitle: {count} company highlight(s) extracted from brochures (review in Company Profile for buyer matching)
onboarding.briefPlaceholder: e.g. Manufacturer of 700W bifacial solar modules and commercial storage systems, CE/TUV certified, supplying European distributors and EPC contractors.
onboarding.briefHint: No website needed — start in 30 seconds from a short product description.
onboarding.comtradeBasis: Reference HS codes: {codes} ({year} trade data, advisory only)
onboarding.comtradeHint: Click any market badge to add it to your target markets (nothing is auto-selected).
onboarding.inlineFactsNote: When launching in the next step, admins automatically confirm these onboarding facts so buyer discovery starts without extra approval hops.
onboarding.reviewTitle: Review your three-layer buyer profile and launch discovery
onboarding.reviewSubtitle: Seller specs stay separate from buyer filters, and peer manufacturers are excluded automatically.
onboarding.launchingStepSaving: Saving profile and confirming key facts…
onboarding.launchingStepPlan: Creating sourcing plan and starting discovery…
onboarding.launchPartialFallback: Company profile saved. Redirected to Buyer profiles so you can finish launching discovery.

onboarding.companyNamePlaceholder: e.g. Shenzhen Acme Technology Co., Ltd.
onboarding.websiteInvalidHint: Enter a valid website domain or URL, e.g. example.com or https://example.com
onboarding.websiteHint: Enter a domain directly (https:// is added automatically) — we read your homepage, products and certifications pages in 1–3 minutes
onboarding.emailDomainHint: This email domain differs from your website — is it your company email?
onboarding.emailFreeHint: A public email domain can reduce buyer trust; a company-domain email is better
onboarding.startHint: Takes 1–3 minutes; you can confirm the results when it finishes
onboarding.progressHint: Usually 1–3 minutes — please keep this page open. The results will appear here for you to confirm.

onboarding.marketsDesc: Tick the countries you want to export to; sourcing and due diligence follow these priorities
onboarding.marketsOptionalHint: Target markets are optional. Saving only stores your company profile — no market analysis or buyer sourcing starts
onboarding.success: Company profile created — you are all set

sources.title: Data sources
sources.subtitle: Enable approved channels or import your own buyer lists into this company’s private pool.
sources.availableDesc: Channels approved by the platform. Once enabled, discovery tasks consume the pool they build.
sources.availableEmpty: No channels available yet. Approved channels appear here.
sources.crawlGateNote: Crawl executions need the platform crawl budget authority; until it is approved, Trial reports it is unavailable. Import channels are unaffected.
sources.importDesc: Upload a CSV (sample template available), map the columns, preview duplicates/suppression, then commit. A 200-row list usually reaches the quick-scan pool within two minutes.
sources.importResult: Import finished (batch {batch}): {total} rows, {materialized} added, {duplicate} duplicates, {suppressed} suppressed, {invalid} invalid.
sources.importDone: Imported {count} companies; they are available to discovery tasks now.
sources.registryDesc: Platform channel status and failure streak (auto-disabled after three rounds above 30%).
sources.createChannelDesc: Register a private import channel for your lists (visible only in this company) to track output by source.
sources.channelCreated: Channel created (disabled by default; imports still work).

campaigns.title: Campaign plans
campaigns.subtitle: Have the system draft what to do, how large, and the budget cap; it only takes effect after your approval. Shadow period: approvals do not execute.
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Create one, then let the system draft a plan.
campaigns.shadowBanner: Approvals issue an execution authorization and proceed to execution; sending remains gated by jurisdiction consent and channel authorization.
campaigns.draftRetryHint: You can start another draft (a new id is generated).
campaigns.whyTechnicalHint: Raw plan and validation info (for engineers)
campaigns.declineReasonRequired: Please provide a reason for declining.
campaigns.approveDone: Approved. An execution authorization was issued.
campaigns.approvalExpired: Approval expired (timeout = decline). Please submit again.
campaigns.approveConfirm: Approving issues an execution authorization and proceeds under it.

qgos.title: Opportunities
qgos.subtitle: Evidenced opportunities, manual sales acceptance and outcome logging — the fuel for attribution and unit economics.
qgos.emptyDesc: Accept a lead in Buyers, then use “Promote to opportunity” to attach demand/timing evidence and a next step.
qgos.saoPending: Not decided yet — accepting or declining leaves a human record.
qgos.acceptedNotice: Accepted — the opportunity is now in follow-up.

outreach.countryInvalid: Use a 2-letter uppercase country code (e.g. IT, US, GB) or leave blank.

outreach.countryMissingWarning: Recipient country code is empty; drafts without a country code are skipped before sending.

outreach.subtitle: Drafts are reviewed before sending; approval only queues the batch, and nothing is sent until the channel is enabled.
outreach.empty: No outreach batches yet. Create one, add drafts, then submit for approval.
outreach.selectHint: Select a batch to review drafts and approval.
outreach.decisionReasonHint: A reason is recommended when declining
outreach.subject: Subject
outreach.contactRefHint: Copy from an accepted opportunity contact

outreach.attachmentsPlaceholder: Select ready brochures from company library

outreach.readinessShadowHint: Shadow mode is active: executing delivery validates all compliance gates and logs events without transmitting e-mails.

t1.dnsTitle: Live SPF / DKIM / DMARC / MX inspection
t1.dnsDesc: Verifies all four critical DNS records directly via standard DNS lookup to protect sender reputation.
t1.dnsReady: All four records configured and ready

dnsAdvice.SPF_OK: SPF record is present with explicit policy.
dnsAdvice.SPF_MISSING: Missing SPF record: publish a v=spf1 TXT record for the sending domain.
dnsAdvice.DKIM_MISSING: No DKIM TXT record found for this selector — enable 2048-bit signing in your mail admin console.
dnsAdvice.DMARC_OK: DMARC is active with quarantine or reject enforcement.
dnsAdvice.DMARC_MONITOR_ONLY: DMARC is in monitor mode (p=none); ramp up to quarantine after 3 clean weeks.
dnsAdvice.DMARC_NO_RUA: DMARC lacks a rua reporting address; add one to track bounces and spoofing.
dnsAdvice.DMARC_MISSING: Missing DMARC record: publish at least p=none on _dmarc.
dnsAdvice.MX_OK: MX records are configured to receive buyer replies and bounces.
dnsAdvice.MX_MISSING: Missing MX records — replies and DSN bounces cannot be delivered.

t1.healthDesc: Breakers pause sending automatically when bounce or complaint rates exceed thresholds; recover via Half-open then Close.
t1.healthEmpty: No circuit breakers open. All sender domains and mailboxes are healthy.
t1.healthReasonPlaceholder: Enter root cause or verification note (required)
t1.warmupDesc: Tracks 7-day seed inbox placement (>=80%), spam rate (<=10%), and daily/weekly mailbox caps.
t1.warmupEmpty: No sender domains or mailboxes registered yet.
t1.warmupSeedMissing: No seed test recorded in the past 7 days
t1.templatesDesc: New templates start as drafts and require a matching approved legal review before activation.
t1.seqDesc: Schedules 2–4 follow-up rounds and hard-stops all remaining touches immediately upon any reply, opt-out, bounce, suppression, or strict country rule.
t1.seqCreated: Follow-up sequence created with live compliance guardrails.

seqStopReason.REPLY_RECEIVED: Buyer reply received — remaining automated rounds hard-stopped
seqStopReason.HARD_BOUNCE: Hard bounce recorded — remaining rounds stopped
seqStopReason.SUPPRESSED: Matched suppression list — all rounds blocked
seqStopReason.JURISDICTION_BLOCKED: Strict opt-in country without consent — blocked

suppressions.title: Do-not-contact list
suppressions.subtitle: Listed e-mails, domains or companies are blocked before any outbound action. Legal entries are never physically deleted — removal goes through a recorded release request.
suppressions.addHint: Takes effect immediately: new leads matching the entry land in the do-not-contact queue and every outbound action re-checks the list.
suppressions.empty: The list is empty. Unsubscribes, complaints and manual entries appear here.
suppressions.releaseConfirm: Request release for “{value}”? Legal entries are never deleted — this action leaves an audit record.
suppressions.releaseRequested: Release requested: the record is kept and enters review (it is not lifted immediately).
suppressions.releaseHint: Note: release requests are append-only records; legal entries need review before release, and unsubscribe/complaint entries are not recommended for release.
suppressions.errEmail: That e-mail address is not valid.
suppressions.added: Added to the list — effective immediately.

reviews.title: Judgment reviews
reviews.subtitle: Judgments the machine could not make confidently, or that need sampling, land here: claim a task, then decide from the criteria and evidence. The original judgment stays; your review is recorded separately.
reviews.emptyDesc: No reviews waiting; new review tasks enter the queue by priority.
reviews.emptyFiltered: No review tasks match these filters
reviews.emptyFilteredHint: Try another status or priority, or refresh to see the latest queue.
reviews.criteriaEmpty: This judgment has no criteria detail to show.
reviews.claimHint: Once you claim this task it is yours; other members will not pick it up.
reviews.resolveHint: Pick a decision and add a reason. The original judgment stays; a new review record is written.
reviews.notePlaceholder: State the basis for your decision so it can be traced later.
reviews.resolvedNotice: Decision submitted; the queue is updated.
reviews.expiredReadonly: This task has expired and can no longer be reviewed.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.subtitle: Read the paired VRIC trend first, then check observations and rollups against the metric dictionary. Missing data stays blank and is never shown as zero.
metrics.vricSub: Reachable people per 1,000 matched accounts: the strict measure (valid email only) is for external commitments, the plus measure (valid email or phone) for internal operations.
metrics.vricEmpty: No VRIC rollups in this window yet
metrics.vricEmptyHint: Buckets appear here once the rollup task has produced them; missing buckets are never shown as zero.
metrics.chartAriaLatest: Paired VRIC trend chart; latest bucket {bucket}: strict {strict}, plus {plus}
metrics.windowTruncated: Window truncated: narrow the range to see earlier buckets
metrics.vricGapNote: A line breaks where one side has no data — a gap means missing data, not zero.
metrics.catalogEmptyHint: Metrics appear by tier once the dictionary sync completes.
metrics.rowsEmptyHint: Try another metric or date range; data is produced by daily and weekly rollup tasks.

marketCandidates.title: Market candidates
marketCandidates.subtitle: Exploratory hypotheses grounded in saved materials, not verified market or procurement facts.
marketCandidates.notAnalyzedDesc: Review seller materials first. No readable document does not mean no market.
marketCandidates.prepareHint: Prepares intent only. Generation starts only after an explicit execution action.
marketCandidates.executeHint: Generation may incur a cost. Rely on actual records.
marketCandidates.emptyResultHint: A valid empty result is not the same as no market opportunity.
marketCandidates.loadFailed: Could not read market candidates. Retry explicitly.
marketCandidates.confirmHint: Feedback on this revision is not fact verification or permission to execute.
marketCandidates.correctHint: A substantive correction targets this hypothesis. Related judgments need reassessment.
marketCandidates.rejectHint: Rejects this combination only, not a whole country or product line.
marketCandidates.emptyCorrection: Provide a substantive correction before saving.
marketCandidates.saved: Feedback recorded. Market and procurement facts are not thereby verified.
marketCandidates.saveFailed: Feedback result pending. Your input is preserved.
marketCandidates.versionConflict: The version changed. Your input is preserved; review current content and decide again.
marketCandidates.idempotencyConflict: This request identity has different content. Preserve your input and check the current result.
marketCandidates.leaveWarning: Leave and discard unsaved feedback? Cancel to preserve your input.
marketCandidates.b4Boundary: Finding buyers is a separate action. This panel creates no task, contact or message.
marketCandidates.costUnknown: Cost unknown. Rely on actual records.
marketCandidates.refreshPending: The result is pending. Query the original operation.
marketCandidates.volatileNotice: Context storage is unavailable. References are volatile and cannot be recovered after reload.
marketCandidates.unreadable: The response is unreadable. Query the original operation or reread.
marketCandidates.correctionOverlay: User correction overlay; original proposal unchanged
marketCandidates.feedbackUnknown: Submission result pending. Explicitly retry the original request; do not assume it was unsaved.
marketCandidates.confirmation: Feedback concerns this revision of the hypothesis only
marketCandidates.countryValidation: Use a two-letter country code, or leave blank for unknown.
marketCandidates.newIntentConfirm: Prepare a new generation intent? This is not a free retry of the original operation; cost follows actual records.
marketCandidates.knownRefusalHint: The request was explicitly refused. Check the current revision, then decide again. No identity or submission changes automatically.
marketCandidates.cannotCompare: Current content cannot yet be compared. Read the current revision first.
marketCandidates.heldDraftHint: The previous readable snapshot was removed. Only your own input remains; it cannot currently be compared or submitted.
marketCandidates.correctionLimit: Each list supports at most 200 entries. Reduce it before submitting.
marketCandidates.originalProposal: Original proposal follows. User corrections are listed separately; the proposal is unchanged.
marketCandidates.noReadableTitle: No readable market candidate document yet
marketCandidates.noReadableDesc: Check the original operation above. Candidates appear here once a saved result becomes readable.
marketCandidates.blockedHint: This action is currently unavailable. See the message above.
marketCandidates.errorFallbackTitle: This action could not be completed
marketCandidates.errorFallbackWhy: There is not enough information to confirm the cause.
marketCandidates.errorFallbackNext: Check the existing operation, if any. If you still cannot continue, contact your workspace admin or platform support.
marketCandidates.recoveryHint: You can view this company's facts or documents first; these entries are read-only and never generate or execute automatically.
marketCandidates.prepareValidationTitle: Market candidates could not be prepared
marketCandidates.prepareValidationWhy: The input or basis did not pass validation. This error code alone does not identify the specific cause.
marketCandidates.prepareValidationNext: Use View profile if shown for this company, or More → Documents to check source material. If no suitable entry is available or preparation still fails, contact a workspace admin.
marketCandidates.prepareNoClaimsTitle: No approved facts are available for this preparation
marketCandidates.prepareNoClaimsWhy: Market candidates require valid, approved facts for this company.
marketCandidates.prepareNoClaimsNext: Where View profile is available, review To review and Approved facts with an authorized admin. If no entry is available or preparation still fails, contact an admin, then retry explicitly.

threeLayer.sellerDesc: Your products, technical specs, and credentials only boost ranking and outreach copy — kept separate from buyer filters.
threeLayer.buyerDesc: Target export markets and downstream buyer roles that drive sourcing and qualification.

streaming.title: Live three-stage discovery progress
streaming.progressiveHint: Progresses from L0 recall to L1 fast extraction & scoring and L2 contact verification — inspect matched buyers immediately without waiting for completion.
